cases.subject: Build access needed immediately
cases.body: Please restore my build access urgently now. The deployment is blocked and the team cannot release until you fix my account permissions. I need your help before the customer session starts in an hour.

cases.subject: Weekend planning
cases.body: Could you send me the address of the restaurant when you have a moment? I am planning our Saturday dinner and will share the route with everyone. No rush, tomorrow is perfectly fine too.
